question: Can unchanged M6 spontaneously produce an 8-particle bonded ring occupying the exact perimeter of a 3×3 lattice block, and thereby passively trap a native free particle in the center?

sample.source: Original M6 natural zero-bond start, 24x24 periodic grid, species baseline/enriched as in M6.4, no synthetic ring

geometry.ring: Connected native component with exactly 8 material IDs, 8 native bonds and degree 2 for all; the occupied coordinates are precisely the 8 perimeter sites of a periodic 3x3 block; center is unique.
geometry.center: At the first post-tick observation of this ring episode, one unbonded native particle (degree 0) of nonzero move_probability may occupy its center. No manual placement.
geometry.other: Record other simple 8-cycles and >=10 cycles but do not classify them as a 3x3 pocket.

episodes.start: First observed native material+edge 8-ring forming the exact 3x3 border.
episodes.stop: First native original-edge break BondEvent even if reformed within same tick, or a changed/missing ring or geometry at a snapshot.
episodes.duration: Consecutive observed post-step ticks; t600 right-censored.
episodes.resident: Track original center particle persistent ID, degree and position while all original 8 ring IDs remain in their original border sites. If resident leaves with border intact, raise an invariant violation.

measurement.primary: Number of distinct native 3x3 perimeter ring episodes and source worlds, with native central monomer at episode start and uninterrupted enclosure for >=30 ticks.
measurement.secondary: Other 8-member rings, >=10 rings, exact ring signature and native source edges/IDs, duration censored, resident species and IDs, all null worlds, physical hashes and RNG, replay checks.

decision.replicated: If >=2 distinct worlds each contain an 8-ring trapping a native degree-0 center particle with nonzero movement probability for >=30 observed ticks, label replicated_natural_geometric_trapping_without_biological_membrane.
decision.single: If exactly one world meets this duration criterion, label one_exploratory_geometric_trap_case.
decision.other: If qualifying rings exist but not >=30-tick trapped resident, label geometric_pocket_without_long_lived_trapping.
decision.null: If no qualifying 3x3 ring exists, label not_observed_under_preregistered_sample.
